riley: Heads-up PR #2148 touches PATCH /v1/models/{id}/config example. The example uses kebab-case fields like "max-tokens" and "warm-up" but OpenAPI schema uses snake_case (max_tokens, warm_up). This trips codegen and lints. cc @sam @tan

sam: Link?

riley: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2148 - author said they mirrored an old internal example, backend accepts both but our docs should be canonical.

tan: openapi-lint will flag example vs schema mismatch. Also SDK generators will create different structs depending on canonical casing. We need to keep canonical example matching the schema.

docs-bot: openapi-lint: example/type-mismatch: /paths/~1v1~1models~1{id}~1config/patch/requestBody/content/application~1json/schema expected properties [max_tokens,warm_up] but found [max-tokens,warm-up] in example.

marta: Suggestion: revert the example to snake_case, add a small "Compatibility" note showing legacy kebab-case and a tiny helper to normalize keys for JS/Python. That way we document what clients should tolerate without breaking schema.

riley: Agreed. Proposed JS helper in the note: `function normalizeConfigKeys(obj){ return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(obj).map(([k,v]) => [k.replace(/-/g,'_'), v])); }` and Python: `def normalize_config_keys(d): return {k.replace('-', '_'): v for k,v in d.items()}`. Keep them short.

sam: Also add a quick line in the SDK migration guide: "If you see unexpected fields in user payloads, normalize kebab-case to snake_case before validation." And add a fixture examples/fixtures/patch-config-kebab.json with the legacy form for tests.

docs-bot: ci/checks: openapi-lint failing until canonical example matches schema.

riley: Will update PR: revert example to snake_case, append compatibility note + JS/Python snippets, add fixture, and include a one-line changelog: "Docs: clarify PATCH model config field casing and add normalization snippets for legacy kebab-case payloads." Pushing commit now.

tan: Quick nit: in JS snippet maybe show `const normalized = normalizeConfigKeys(payload)` usage in the example request body so it's explicit.

riley: Good call, will include that one-liner. Pushed.

docs-bot: ci/checks: examples-validate passed. openapi-lint passed.

sam: Reviewing. Looks good. Small suggestion for Python snippet to handle nested objects if needed but optional.

marta: LGTM. Merge when green.

riley: Merged. Closing thread. :tada:
